title: one image's training caption at one moment
description: One line of <home>/projects/<slug>/captions.jsonl: one caption per image; the latest line per image wins. Only `approved` captions are frozen or trained on. `source` is who wrote the text: operator, the second source, or a tool for drafts (for example kiln:captions propose).

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

v.description: the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string

lint.description: the lint findings when the line was written

by.description: the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional)

legacy_id.description: the record's id in the store it was exported from; null for records made here. Kept so a migrated record can be traced back; never shown in public text

relpath.description: a path relative to the root its record names: forward slashes, no drive, no leading slash, no `..`

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. New records always use T and carry the UTC offset; times exported from an older store may use a space and lack the offset.

who.description: where the line's content comes from: `operator` (the person), the second source (policy.second_source_name, default `assistant`), or a tool, for example `kiln:images import` or `export:legacy`
